text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Perkapalan Saudagar (Fi Tahunan bagi Lesen Kerja Perkhidmatan dan

Kerja Pelabuhan) 2026.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2027.

Fi tahunan

2. (1) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang menyediakan apa-apa kerja

perkhidmatan atau kerja pelabuhan hendaklah membayar fi tahunan mengikut kategori

kerja perkhidmatan atau kerja pelabuhan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Fi tahunan yang telah dibayar di bawah subperaturan (1) tidak boleh

dikembalikan.

MERCHANT SHIPPING ORDINANCE 1952

MERCHANT SHIPPING (ANNUAL FEE FOR LICENCE OF SERVICE UNDERTAKINGS AND

PORT UNDERTAKINGS) REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 10A(7)(a) of the

Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1952 [Ordinance 70/1952], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Merchant Shipping

(Annual Fee for Licence of Service Undertakings and Port Undertakings)

Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2027.

Annual fee

2. (1) Any licensee who provides any service undertaking or port undertaking

shall pay the annual fee in accordance with the categories of service undertakings or

port undertakings as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The annual fee which has been paid under subregulation (1) shall not

be refundable.
